definitions.gloss: heavy snowfall; extreme snow; blizzard-level snow
definitions.explanation: An exceptionally large amount of snowfall, significantly beyond normal levels. Used in weather reports and when describing regions or events affected by extreme snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪雪|ごうせつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: This year was terrible because of the heavy snowfall.

examples.japanese: {豪雪|ごうせつ}{地帯|ちたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雪下|ゆきお}ろし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In heavy-snow regions, clearing snow off roofs is essential.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{豪雪|ごうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{交通機関|こうつうきかん}→交通機関：21264_koutsuukikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数日間|すうじつかん}⟦{麻痺|まひ}→麻痺：09013_mahi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Record-breaking heavy snow paralyzed transportation for several days.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently appears in weather reports and news. Japan has officially designated {豪雪|ごうせつ}{地帯|ちたい} (heavy-snow zones), particularly along the Sea of Japan coast, where annual snowfall is exceptionally high.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪雪|ごうせつ}{地帯|ちたい} (heavy-snow zone/region)
- {豪雪|ごうせつ}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (damage from heavy snow)
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{豪雪|ごうせつ} (record-breaking snowfall)
- {豪雪|ごうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ (to be hit by heavy snow)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧: heavy snow — more everyday term for a lot of snow
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard — specifically snow with strong wind
